paper_title: NP-Hardness of Coloring 2-Colorable Hypergraph with Poly-Logarithmically Many Colors
classifications: Theory of computation → Complexity theory and logic
statement: hardness of approximation as well as in other areas which use the Long Code or similar objects. We conclude with a couple of obvious interesting open problems: 1. Can we show that coloring a 2-colorable 3-uniform hypergraph with ω(log log n) colors is NP-hard, or even quasi-NP-hard? 2. Can we go beyond poly(log n) coloring NP-hardness factor for coloring a c-colorable k-uniform hypergraph for some constants c ≥ 2 and k ≥ 3?
